about: Retrieval gold set scaffold for Phase B. A fixture library (meeting notes and Agent conversations) and questions whose answer is one passage, named by its source key and a phrase it contains. --selftest-search indexes it in a temporary directory and reports recall@10 and MRR for BM25, cosine and the fused ranking. Questions of kind vocabulary share no word with their answer, so BM25 cannot find them by construction. Written by hand; no real meeting is committed.

meetings.title: Project Atlas kickoff
meetings.notes:
## Summary

Project Atlas replaces the legacy billing system by the end of Q2.

## Key points

- Priya Raman leads the Atlas migration team.
- The old invoicing service is written in Perl and has no tests.

## Decisions

- Atlas will ship behind a feature flag to five percent of accounts first.
- The team chose PostgreSQL over DynamoDB for the ledger.

## Action items

- **Marco** — draft the data migration runbook by January 16.

## Open questions

- Whether finance needs an audit trail export.

meetings.title: Pricing review
meetings.notes:
## Summary

The team reviewed the new pricing page.

## Key points

- The annual plan discount moves from 15% to 20%.
- Enterprise pricing stays on the contact form.

## Decisions

- Ship the new pricing page on Friday January 16.
- Sam owns the launch ads budget of 4,000 dollars.

## Action items

- **Ana** — publish the pricing page and announce it in the newsletter.

## Open questions

- Should the starter tier include API access?

meetings.title: Hiring sync
meetings.notes:
## Key points

- Candidate Lena Ortiz passed the system design interview.
- The interview loop drops the take-home assignment.
- Salary bands for senior engineers get published internally in March.

## Decisions

- Open a second backend engineer role before the budget review.

## Action items

- **Dev** — write the job description for the data engineer opening.

meetings.title: Checkout outage postmortem
meetings.notes:
## Summary

Checkout was down for 47 minutes on January 24 after a certificate expired.

## Key points

- Root cause: the TLS certificate renewal job had been disabled during the datacenter move.
- About 1,200 orders failed during the incident.

## Decisions

- Certificate expiry alerts page the on-call engineer 14 days ahead.

## Action items

- **Kenji** — add a synthetic check for the payment flow.

meetings.title: Q1 planning
meetings.notes:
## Key points

- Revenue target for Q1 is 2.4 million.
- Mobile app redesign slips to Q2 because the design lead is on parental leave.
- Marketing spend shifts from paid search to partner webinars.

## Decisions

- Freeze new integrations until Atlas lands.

## Open questions

- Whether to hire a second product designer.

meetings.title: Acme Corp renewal call
meetings.notes:
## Key points

- Acme wants single sign-on with Okta before renewing.
- Their contract renews on April 30 for 120 seats.
- Acme reported that exports time out above 50,000 rows.

## Decisions

- Offer Acme a two-month extension at the current rate.

## Action items

- **Ana** — send Acme the security questionnaire answers.

meetings.title: Office move
meetings.notes:
## Key points

- The Lisbon team moves to the new office on Rua Augusta on March 2.
- Desks are unassigned; bookings go through the Robin app.
- Parking is not included; the company reimburses public transport passes.

## Decisions

- Engineering laptops get upgraded to M4 MacBook Pros.

meetings.title: Security review
meetings.notes:
## Key points

- Password rotation every 90 days is dropped in favour of mandatory two-factor authentication.
- A contractor laptop was lost in February; its disk was encrypted.
- A penetration test with Cobalt is scheduled for April.

## Decisions

- All production database access goes through the bastion host.

## Action items

- **Kenji** — rotate the Stripe API keys by March 6.

meetings.title: Offsite planning
meetings.notes:
## Key points

- The company offsite is in Porto from May 12 to May 14.
- Budget for the offsite is 30,000 euros.

## Decisions

- No work sessions on the last day; it is a team activity day.

## Action items

- **Lena** — book the vans for the airport transfer.

meetings.title: Churn analysis
meetings.notes:
## Key points

- Monthly churn rose to 3.1 percent in February.
- Most cancellations cite the missing Xero integration.
- Customers on the starter tier churn twice as often as annual customers.

## Decisions

- Build the Xero integration in Q2 despite the integrations freeze.

meetings.title: Q2 roadmap
meetings.notes:
## Key points

- Q2 themes: Atlas general availability, the Xero integration and the mobile redesign.

## Decisions

- The public API v2 is postponed to Q3.

## Action items

- **Priya** — present the roadmap at the all-hands on March 20.

## Open questions

- Whether the analytics dashboard rewrite fits in Q2.

meetings.title: People policy update
meetings.notes:
## Key points

- Unlimited paid time off is replaced by 28 days of annual leave plus public holidays.
- Unused leave carries over up to five days.
- Parental leave is extended to 20 weeks for all parents.

## Decisions

- The office closes between Christmas and New Year.

turns.text: Draft a note to the board that the Atlas migration is on track for June.
Here is a draft: Atlas remains on track for a June go-live.
What's the wifi password at the Lisbon office?
I don't have it. Rita, the office manager, keeps it.
